description: Create a new auth key for the tailnet (used to register new devices). Tailscale REST: POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys.

description.description: A short description for the key.

ephemeral.description: If true, devices registered with this key are ephemeral (removed shortly after going offline).

expirySeconds.description: Key lifetime in seconds; 0 means no expiry (if allowed by tailnet policy).

preauthorized.description: If true, devices registered with this key are pre-authorized (skip device approval).

reusable.description: If true, the key can register multiple devices.

tags.description: ACL tags to apply to devices created with this key, e.g. ["tag:ci"].

name: tailscale_create_auth_key
title: Create auth key
